MLC Election: Astrologer Acharya Indu Prakash Mishra is being trolled after his wife Smita Mishra lost the Lucknow Graduates’ seat with under 300 votes. In Rajasthan, astrologer and face reader Omprakash Bishnoi also drew attention after securing just 33 votes in a panchayat election. Both cases raise a key question: Can social media popularity really translate into votes?
